blocks.text: PHILADELPHIA — LeBron James laughed as he recalled how, early in his first 76ers training camp, a couple of his passes clocked VJ Edgecombe in the head. The lesson from James was this: When he has the ball, his teammates should always finish their routes and keep their heads up. LeBron is watching. “I told him, even when you don’t think you’re open, you’re going to be open,” James said.
